# Glitch Games

> Glitch Games is a free browser gaming platform with 70+ arcade, classic, and indie games. Players earn coins, climb leaderboards, unlock achievements, and join clans.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and play 70+ free games, see featured picks and trending titles.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Global rankings across every game with filters by game and timeframe.
- [Rewards](/rewards): Daily login rewards, battle pass, and currency shop.
- [Social](/social): Clans, followers, parties, and tournaments.
- [Profile](/profile): Player stats, achievements, friends, and customization.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Account sign-in and registration.
- [Settings](/settings): Theme, accessibility, privacy, and notification preferences.
